sub_sections.title: Concerning Strategy
sub_sections.description_text:
If you're not sure on how to win a phase, if the enemy's defense/offense is just too strong, check out Dr. Bopsu's guide:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1976271077

sub_sections.title: Intro
sub_sections.description_text:
Because the sooner y'all get better at invasion, the more fun it will be for everybody.

This guide is about knowledge of power weapons, which will drive you (partially) to success. You will additionally need team work and game sense, but there will be another guide about that. Hopefully.

Since I have no clue on how to access the Forge Maps, this will only be about the locations of power weapons on the original Reach and DLC maps.

In case of missing power weapons, tell me so I can add them.
